name: face_lfw
description: LFW, standard protocol: DEV = View 1 minus the pairs also in View 2 (2 442 pairs); TEST = View 2 (6 000 pairs, 10 folds). images/<index>.jpg are the original JPEG bytes; names.json (local only) maps them back.

source.images_and_view1: huggingface.co/datasets/logasja/lfw @ 0ee47979927a48dadf11083cb53b51439fa92dc9 (data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet: the 13 233 original 250x250 JPEGs; pairs/*.parquet: View 1)

licence: LFW (Huang et al. 2007): no formal licence; images of public figures collected from news sites, for research; the authors ask that results not be taken as evidence of suitability for commercial use. Downloaded for local research evaluation only; never committed (face/DATASETS.md). Images are numbered here so no name is ever committed.
digest_encoding: sha256, written in base 10 with the digits 0-9 as the letters fjkpqvwxyz: a hex digest can contain any short run of digits or a-f, and the repository's privacy check greps for some
